description: The one way to start a character, from whatever the user gave: nothing (random), a text brief, a concept image, or a concept image plus a brief. Rolls the DNA they are born with (a temperament of six 0-100 scales), a coherent ENGINE that lands on it (wound → lie → fear → worst trait / best trait → truth → arc) and surprising SPARKS — by default 3 competing variants of the same concept for the variant tournament — and says how to treat the brief and the image. Same seed = same roll.

anchor.description: Role every variant shares, e.g. 'fisherman', 'court jester', 'mascot for a bakery'.

brief.description: The user's description of the character, verbatim, if they gave one.

concept.description: Path or URL of the user's own concept image, if they gave one. It becomes the winner's concept instead of a generated one.

genre.description: Fix the genre instead of rolling it.

medium.description: Fix the medium instead of rolling it.

setting.description: Fix the setting instead of rolling it.

variants.description: How many competing variants. Default 3 (the tournament); 1 only when the user asks for one quick character.

name: character_create
title: Start a new character
